chunks: And from him, from al-Barqi, from Sa'd ibn Sa'd al-Ash'ari, from Abi al-Hasan al-Rida عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about qunut: is qunut performed in all salat (prayer), or only in those in which the recitation is audible? He said: There is no qunut except in the morning prayer, the witr, Jumu'ah, and the maghrib prayer.

key_terms.الْغَدَاةِ: the morning prayer, meaning salat al-fajr
key_terms.الْقُنُوتِ: the supplicatory devotion performed in a standing position during salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: In which prayers is qunut performed according to Imam al-Rida عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of qunut within salat (prayer) and specifies the prayers in which it is to be performed. It presents a concise legal teaching from Imam al-Rida عليه السلام concerning the sunnah (prophetic tradition) of qunut in worship.
